1.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

2.web: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),
2.asv: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to the borders thereof),

3.web: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
3.asv: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward;

4.web: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.
4.asv: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out thereof shall be southward of Kadesh-barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar-addar, and pass along to Azmon;

5.web: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.
5.asv: and the border shall turn about from Azmon unto the brook of Egypt, and the goings out thereof shall be at the sea.

6.web: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.
6.asv: And for the western border, ye shall have the great sea and the borderthereof: this shall be your west border.

7.web: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.
7.asv: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall mark out for you mount Hor;

8.web: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
8.asv: from mount Hor ye shall mark out unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;

9.web: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
9.asv: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out thereof shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.

10.web: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
10.asv: And ye shall mark out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham;

11.web: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.
11.asv: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;

12.web: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”
12.asv: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and the goings out thereof shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to the borders thereof round about.

13.web: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
13.asv: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which Jehovah hath commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

14.web: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance.
14.asv: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance:

15.web: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”
15.asv: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

16.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

17.web: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
17.asv: These are the names of the men that shall divide the land unto you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

18.web: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
18.asv: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

19.web: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
19.asv: And these are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

20.web: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
20.asv: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

21.web: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
21.asv: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

22.web: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.
22.asv: And of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

23.web: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
23.asv: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

24.web: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
24.asv: And of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

25.web: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
25.asv: And of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

26.web: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
26.asv: And of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

27.web: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
27.asv: And of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

28.web: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”
28.asv: And of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

29.web: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
29.asv: These are they whom Jehovah commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
